description: An edge-to-edge square abstract painting with broad, softly layered fields of warm gray and muted violet. A dense passage of dark plum brushwork sits off center, while sparse apricot strokes introduce a light irregular rhythm. Thin scraped textures and generous pale space balance the concentrated paint.
prompt: Create a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting in a square format, filling the entire image edge to edge. Use broad, softly layered fields of warm gray and muted violet, with a dense off-center passage of dark plum brushwork. Introduce sparse apricot gestures with an irregular, unhurried rhythm. Alternate translucent washes with thick matte paint and thin scraped textures. Let generous pale empty space balance the concentrated pigment, with subtle spatial tension and varied soft and abrupt edges. Keep every mark wholly abstract. Use only color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, records, tiles, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.
